name: Offer acceptance and withdrawal
description: Reject illegal transitions before and after acceptance.

name: Conditional, active, and fulfilled
description: Require all triggers and an outcome after activation.
testCode:
import main
r={'when':['a','b'],'do':'c','within':2}
assert main.commitment_state(r,{'a':[0]},8)=='CONDITIONAL'
assert main.commitment_state(r,{'a':[0],'b':[3]},4)=='ACTIVE'
assert main.commitment_state(r,{'a':[0],'b':[3],'c':[2]},4)=='ACTIVE'
assert main.commitment_state(r,{'a':[0],'b':[3],'c':[5]},5)=='FULFILLED'

name: Deadlines and late delivery
description: An outcome on the deadline is timely, but one day later is a violation.
testCode:
import main
r={'when':['a'],'do':'b','within':5}
assert main.commitment_state(r,{'a':[1]},6)=='ACTIVE'
assert main.commitment_state(r,{'a':[1]},7)=='VIOLATED'
assert main.commitment_state(r,{'a':[1],'b':[6]},8)=='FULFILLED'
assert main.commitment_state(r,{'a':[1],'b':[7]},8)=='VIOLATED'

name: Six campaign scenarios
description: Check the ledger states and deduplicated payment.
testCode:
import main
s={n:main.run_case(n) for n in main.SCENARIOS}
status=lambda n,k:next(c['status'] for c in s[n]['ledger'] if c['id']==k)
assert all(status('SUCCESS',f'K{i}')=='FULFILLED' for i in range(1,6))
assert status('LATE_DELIVERY','K2')=='VIOLATED'
assert status('PAYOUT_MISSED','K5')=='VIOLATED'
assert all(status('WITHDRAWN_OFFER',f'K{i}')=='CONDITIONAL' for i in range(1,6))
assert status('COMPLIANCE_REJECTED','K4')=='CONDITIONAL'
assert status('COMPLIANCE_REJECTED','K5')=='CONDITIONAL'
assert s['DUPLICATE_PAYOUT']['event_count']==s['SUCCESS']['event_count']

name: Independent agents generate valid events
description: Creator, compliance, brand, and payment agents produce correctly timed messages.
testCode:
import main
p=main.AGENT_POLICIES['AGENT_NORMAL']
a=main.agent_reactions({'id':'x','day':0,'type':'offer_accepted'},p)
assert [e['type'] for e in a]==['escrow_funded'] and a[0]['day']==1
b=main.agent_reactions({'id':'x','day':1,'type':'escrow_funded'},p)
assert [e['type'] for e in b]==['video_submitted'] and b[0]['day']==4
c=main.agent_reactions({'id':'x','day':4,'type':'video_submitted'},p)
assert [e['type'] for e in c]==['compliance_passed']
r=main.agent_reactions({'id':'x','day':5,'type':'compliance_passed'},p)
assert {e['type'] for e in r}=={'brand_reviewed','brand_approved'}
pay=main.agent_reactions({'id':'x','day':7,'type':'video_published'},p)
assert len(pay)==1 and pay[0]['type']=='payout_requested' and pay[0]['attempt']==1

name: Agent-driven delivery, retries and outage
description: Run event-driven campaigns with late delivery, retry, outage, and rejected content.
testCode:
import main
cases={n:main.run_case(n) for n in main.AGENT_POLICIES}
status=lambda n,k:next(c['status'] for c in cases[n]['ledger'] if c['id']==k)
assert all(status('AGENT_NORMAL',f'K{i}')=='FULFILLED' for i in range(1,6))
assert status('AGENT_CREATOR_LATE','K2')=='VIOLATED'
assert status('AGENT_PAYMENT_RETRY','K5')=='FULFILLED'
assert status('AGENT_PAYMENT_OUTAGE','K5')=='VIOLATED'
assert status('AGENT_REJECTED','K4')=='CONDITIONAL'
assert status('AGENT_REJECTED','K5')=='CONDITIONAL'
retry=cases['AGENT_PAYMENT_RETRY']
assert sum(e['type']=='payout_settled' for e in retry['events'])==1
assert sum(e['type']=='payout_requested' for e in retry['events'])==3
assert all(a['day']<=b['day'] for a,b in zip(retry['events'],retry['events'][1:]))
